#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <set>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

string initial(int a, int b) {
    string s;
    for (int i = 0; i < a; ++i)
        s.push_back('a' + i);
    for (int i = 0; i < b; ++i)
        s.push_back('a' + a - 1);
    return s;
}

string appendMissing(const string& s, int a) {
    vector<bool> used(26, false);
    int start = max(0, (int)s.length() - a);
    for (int i = s.length() - 1; i >= start; --i)
        used[s[i] - 'a'] = true;

    string result = s;
    int need = a;
    for (int i = 0; i < 26 && need > 0; ++i) {
        if (used[i]) continue;
        result.push_back('a' + i);
        --need;
    }
    return result;
}

string appendLast(const string& s, int b) {
    char ch = s.back();
    string result = s;
    for (int i = 0; i < b; ++i)
        result.push_back(ch);
    return result;
}

int main() {
    int a, b, l, r;
    cin >> a >> b >> l >> r;

    string fin = initial(a, b);
    int period = a + b;
    int x = l % period;
    if (x == 0) x = period;
    fin = fin.substr(x - 1);

    fin = appendMissing(fin, a);
    fin = appendLast(fin, b);
    fin = appendMissing(fin, a);
    fin = appendLast(fin, b);

    set<char> distinct;
    int limit = min(r - l, (int)fin.length() - 1);
    for (int i = 0; i <= limit; ++i)
        distinct.insert(fin[i]);

    cout << distinct.size() << endl;
    return 0;
}
